answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, converted to a slow vesting stream. Every claim climbs the plume of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the willow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the jade of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
